terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1: CryptoPro Trader is an educational, autonomous paper-crypto spot trading cockpit. It ships in paper spot trading mode by default and connects to Alpaca's paper trading API, which simulates order execution with no real funds at risk.
terms.p2: Live trading risk. Switching the trading mode to "Live" routes orders to a real brokerage account using your own API keys. Live trading involves substantial risk of loss, including the loss of your entire deposited capital, and is not suitable for every investor. You are solely responsible for any live-mode order this software places on your behalf, and for reviewing every signal, score, and risk parameter before enabling it.
